explication: This tree contains versioned copies of a small performance-charting helper, rather than the Pongo application described by the README. A user invokes the script with a JSON result file and optional output directory; it loads and prepares benchmark data, builds charts, and writes image files. The sampled code shows JSON loading and combined-chart output; intermediate plotting details are partly omitted, so the graph stays at those supported stages.
